heading: Activity report
lead: What this deployment recorded in one calendar month: datasets, access requests, evaluations, models, annotation and the audit trail. Counts and public entries only; no person is named.

actions.printHint: To keep a copy on paper or as PDF, use your browser’s print command.

meta.title: Activity report, {month}
meta.partial: This month is not over: the figures will still move.

datasets.heading: Datasets
datasets.publishedAtEnd: Public datasets published at the end of the period
datasets.none: No version was published in the period.

accessRequests.heading: Access requests
accessRequests.pendingAtEnd: Waiting for a decision at the end of the period
accessRequests.note: Approved and denied count requests that stand at that outcome today: an approval revoked since is not counted.

evaluation.heading: Evaluation
evaluation.none: No task received a submission in the period or holds a published result.
evaluation.note: A result is published once its evaluation method version is approved and it has not been retracted. The best result is the task’s best today, whenever it was submitted.

annotation.heading: Annotation
annotation.none: No campaign is running or completed.
annotation.note: Agreement is computed over all tasks read so far, not over the period alone. A dash means the campaign is below the number of tasks needed for a coefficient.

status.intact: Intact ({checked, plural, one {# event} other {# events}} checked)
status.broken: Broken: verify the range in the audit trail reader
status.unverified: Not verified here: the period holds more events than one check covers. Verify the range in the audit trail reader.
